metadata.title: Clippy Capsule Verification - Local CI/CD Integration Guide
metadata.description: Complete guide for enforcing Chaos compliance via local cargo clippy (NO GitHub Actions)
metadata.target-audience: Developers using clippy-capsule-verify for computational capsule verification
metadata.framework: UCE34 Q30-Q34 (Validation + Auditability), Chaos (100% lockfree mandate)

overview.purpose: Local enforcement of computational capsule verification using cargo clippy

tool.name: cargo clippy
tool.desc: Rust linting tool with custom lint support

tool.name: clippy-capsule-verify
tool.desc: Custom lint crate detecting unverified capsules

benefits.benefit: Compile-time capsule verification enforcement (<1ms overhead per capsule)

lint.name: CAPSULE_MUTEX_VIOLATION
lint.description: Detects Mutex/RwLock in capsule structs (violates lockfree mandate)
lint.trigger: #[repr(C, align(N))] struct with Mutex<T> or RwLock<T> field
lint.fix: Replace Mutex with AtomicU64 + DualAtomicU64 patterns

lint.name: CAPSULE_UNALIGNED_VIOLATION
lint.description: Detects size misalignment (size not multiple of alignment)
lint.message: Capsule size X is not multiple of alignment Y (cache-line fragmentation)
lint.fix: Add padding field to reach multiple of alignment

lint.name: CAPSULE_MISSING_GENERATION
lint.description: Detects T1 Atomic capsules without generation counters (TOCTOU prevention)
lint.trigger: #[repr(C, align(N))] with AtomicU64 field but no generation counter
lint.message: T1 Atomic capsule missing generation counter (TOCTOU vulnerability)
lint.fix: Add generation: u32 field packed into AtomicU64 (upper 32 bits)

lint.name: CAPSULE_NON_ATOMIC_FIELD
lint.description: Detects non-atomic fields in T1 Atomic capsules (lockfree violation)
lint.trigger: #[repr(C, align(N))] marked as T1 with non-atomic field (e.g., u64 instead of AtomicU64)
lint.message: T1 Atomic capsule contains non-atomic field (lockfree violation)
lint.fix: Replace primitive types with atomic equivalents

lint.name: MISSING_CAPSULE_VERIFICATION
lint.description: Detects capsules without compile-time verification macros
lint.fix: Add verify_capsule_properties!(StructName, ALIGNMENT, SIZE) or use #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)]

p2-medium-lints.note: P2 lints not yet implemented (planned for v0.2.0)
p2-medium-lints.future-lint: Size much smaller than alignment (wasted cache lines)

clippy-toml-configuration.description: Configure lint levels, suppressions, and custom clippy behavior
clippy-toml-configuration.complete-example:
# Clippy Capsule Verification Configuration # Location: Project root (same directory as Cargo.toml) # Framework: UCE34 Q30-Q34 (Validation + Auditability)
# ============================================================================ # P0 CRITICAL LINTS (DENY - Compile Errors) # ============================================================================
# P0.1: No Mutex/RwLock in capsules (lockfree mandate) capsule-mutex-violation = "deny"
# P0.2: Size must be multiple of alignment (cache-line alignment) capsule-unaligned-violation = "deny"
# P0.3: T1 Atomic capsules need generation counters (TOCTOU prevention) capsule-missing-generation = "deny"
# P0.4: T1 capsules must only use atomic types (lockfree violation) capsule-non-atomic-field = "deny"
# ============================================================================ # P1 HIGH LINTS (WARN - Should Address) # ============================================================================
# P1.0: Capsules need compile-time verification missing-capsule-verification = "warn"
# ============================================================================ # P2 MEDIUM LINTS (ALLOW - Future Enforcement) # ============================================================================
# P2.1-P2.3: Not yet implemented (v0.2.0)
# ============================================================================ # STANDARD CLIPPY CONFIGURATION # ============================================================================
# Enforce standard clippy warnings as errors in CI # (Keep as warnings for local development) all-lints = "warn"
# Specific clippy lints to enforce pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 } nursery = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
# Disable noisy lints # (Capsule patterns have legitimate use cases for these) module-name-repetitions = "allow" struct-excessive-bools = "allow" similar-names = "allow"
# Performance lints (always enforce) perf = { level = "warn", priority = 1 }
# ============================================================================ # MSRV (Minimum Supported Rust Version) # ============================================================================
# Require Rust 1.77.0+ (nightly features via rust-toolchain.toml) msrv = "1.77.0"
# ============================================================================ # CUSTOM LINT THRESHOLDS # ============================================================================
# Complexity thresholds cognitive-complexity-threshold = 25 type-complexity-threshold = 500
# Function thresholds too-many-arguments-threshold = 8 too-many-lines-threshold = 150
# ============================================================================ # ALLOWED EXTERNAL TYPES (FFI EXCEPTIONS) # ============================================================================
# External FFI types that don't need capsule verification # (Controlled by external libraries, not our code) allowed-unverified-types = [ "ExternalCapsule", "LegacyCapsule", ]

usage-notes.note: Place .clippy.toml in project root (same directory as Cargo.toml)
Configuration applies to entire workspace (all crates)
P0 lints set to "deny" will cause compilation errors
P1 lints set to "warn" will show warnings (but allow compilation)

clippy-toml-configuration.validation-command:
# Validate .clippy.toml syntax cargo clippy -- --help | grep -A 5 "clippy.toml"
# Check current lint configuration cargo clippy --explain clippy::capsule_mutex_violation

local-validation-commands.description: Cargo clippy commands for local enforcement (NO GitHub Actions)

cmd.name: check-p0-critical
cmd.usage: # Check P0 critical lints only (fastest check) cargo clippy --all-targets -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field
cmd.purpose: Fast pre-commit check for absolute violations (lockfree, alignment, generation, atomic)

cmd.name: check-all-lints
cmd.usage: # Check all P0 + P1 lints cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field \ -W clippy::missing_capsule_verification
cmd.purpose: Comprehensive check before git push (all custom lints + standard clippy)

cmd.name: check-full-strict
cmd.usage: # Treat all warnings as errors (CI-level strictness) cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cmd.purpose: Final validation before release (zero warnings allowed)

cmd.name: check-workspace
cmd.usage: # Check all workspace members cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field
cmd.purpose: Validate all crates in monorepo workspace

cmd.name: fix-auto
cmd.usage: # Auto-apply clippy suggestions (safe fixes only) cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged
cmd.purpose: Automatically fix simple lints (e.g., unused imports, naming)
cmd.warning: Does NOT fix capsule violations (manual fixes required)

cmd.name: audit-violations
cmd.usage:
# Count all violations by type cargo clippy --all-targets 2>&1 | grep -E "capsule_|missing_capsule" | sort | uniq -c
# Example output: # 15 warning: capsule struct missing compile-time verification # 3 error: capsule contains mutex/rwlock (lockfree mandate violation) # 1 error: capsule size 12 is not multiple of alignment 64

cmd.name: check-specific-file
cmd.usage: # Check specific file only cargo clippy --all-targets -- \ --file src/my_capsule.rs \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation
cmd.purpose: Rapid iteration on single file during development

git-hooks.description: Automated enforcement via git hooks (local enforcement, no remote required)

pre-commit-hook.purpose: Fast P0 critical checks before allowing commit (5-15 seconds)
pre-commit-hook.script:
#!/bin/bash # Pre-Commit Hook: Fast P0 Critical Checks # Location: .git/hooks/pre-commit # Framework: UCE34 Q30 (Validation)
set -e
echo "🔍 [Pre-Commit] Running P0 critical lint checks..."
# P0 critical lints only (fast check) cargo clippy --all-targets --quiet -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "✅ [Pre-Commit] P0 critical checks passed!" exit 0 else echo "❌ [Pre-Commit] P0 critical violations detected!" echo "" echo "Fix the following before committing:" echo " - Remove Mutex/RwLock from capsules (use AtomicU64)" echo " - Add padding to align size to alignment boundary" echo " - Add generation counters to T1 Atomic capsules" echo " - Replace non-atomic fields with atomic types" echo "" echo "To bypass (NOT RECOMMENDED):" echo " git commit --no-verify" exit 1 fi
pre-commit-hook.installation:
# Install pre-commit hook cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # [... script content above ...] EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# Test the hook .git/hooks/pre-commit

pre-push-hook.purpose: Comprehensive P0+P1 checks + tests before push (30-60 seconds)
pre-push-hook.script:
#!/bin/bash # Pre-Push Hook: Comprehensive Validation # Location: .git/hooks/pre-push # Framework: UCE34 Q30-Q34 (Validation + Auditability)
set -e
echo "🔍 [Pre-Push] Running comprehensive validation..."
# Step 1: All clippy lints (P0 + P1) echo "📋 Step 1/3: Clippy lints (P0 + P1)..." cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --quiet -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field \ -W clippy::missing_capsule_verification
# Step 2: Run tests echo "🧪 Step 2/3: Running tests..." cargo test --all-features --quiet
# Step 3: Check formatting echo "🎨 Step 3/3: Checking code formatting..." cargo fmt --all -- --check
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "✅ [Pre-Push] All checks passed! Safe to push." exit 0 else echo "❌ [Pre-Push] Validation failed!" echo "" echo "Fix the following before pushing:" echo " 1. Fix all clippy warnings (cargo clippy)" echo " 2. Fix failing tests (cargo test)" echo " 3. Format code (cargo fmt)" echo "" echo "To bypass (NOT RECOMMENDED FOR PRODUCTION):" echo " git push --no-verify" exit 1 fi
pre-push-hook.installation:
# Install pre-push hook cat > .git/hooks/pre-push << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # [... script content above ...] EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-push
# Test the hook .git/hooks/pre-push

commit-msg-hook.purpose: Enforce commit message format ([TRADE SECRET], [P0 FIX], etc)
commit-msg-hook.installation:
# Install commit-msg hook cat > .git/hooks/commit-msg << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # [... script content above ...] EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/commit-msg

installation-all.description: Install all git hooks at once
installation-all.script:
#!/bin/bash # Install All Git Hooks # Usage: ./install-git-hooks.sh
set -e
HOOKS_DIR=".git/hooks"
echo "📦 Installing git hooks for clippy-capsule-verify..."
# Create hooks directory if it doesn't exist mkdir -p "$HOOKS_DIR"
# Install pre-commit hook cat > "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash set -e echo "🔍 [Pre-Commit] Running P0 critical lint checks..." cargo clippy --all-targets --quiet -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "✅ [Pre-Commit] P0 critical checks passed!" exit 0 else echo "❌ [Pre-Commit] P0 critical violations detected!" exit 1 fi EOF
# Install pre-push hook cat > "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push" << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash set -e echo "🔍 [Pre-Push] Running comprehensive validation..." cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --quiet -- \ -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation \ -D clippy::capsule_missing_generation \ -D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field \ -W clippy::missing_capsule_verification cargo test --all-features --quiet cargo fmt --all -- --check echo "✅ [Pre-Push] All checks passed!" EOF
# Install commit-msg hook cat > "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg" << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash COMMIT_MSG=$(cat "$1") if echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep -qE '^\[(TRADE SECRET|P0 FIX|P1 FIX|FEAT|FIX|REFACTOR|DOCS|TEST)\]'; then exit 0 else echo "❌ Invalid commit message format! Use: [TAG] Description" exit 1 fi EOF
# Make hooks executable chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push" chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
echo "✅ Git hooks installed successfully!" echo "" echo "Installed hooks:" echo " - pre-commit (P0 critical checks, 5-15s)" echo " - pre-push (P0+P1 checks + tests, 30-60s)" echo " - commit-msg (enforce commit message format)" echo "" echo "Test hooks:" echo " .git/hooks/pre-commit" echo " .git/hooks/pre-push"
installation-all.usage:
# Make script executable chmod +x install-git-hooks.sh
# Run installation ./install-git-hooks.sh
# Output: # ✅ Git hooks installed successfully! # Installed hooks: # - pre-commit (P0 critical checks, 5-15s) # - pre-push (P0+P1 checks + tests, 30-60s) # - commit-msg (enforce commit message format)

editor-integration.description: Real-time linting in editors (VSCode, Neovim, Emacs)

usage.step: Install rust-analyzer extension from VSCode marketplace
Open Rust file → See inline clippy diagnostics automatically

neovim.configuration-ale:
" Neovim ALE Configuration for clippy-capsule-verify " Location: ~/.config/nvim/init.vim
" Enable ALE let g:ale_enabled = 1
" Rust linters (clippy) let g:ale_linters = { \ 'rust': ['cargo', 'clippy'], \}
" Clippy arguments (P0 critical lints) let g:ale_rust_clippy_options = '--all-targets -- ' . \ '-D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation ' . \ '-D clippy::capsule_unaligned_violation ' . \ '-D clippy::capsule_missing_generation ' . \ '-D clippy::capsule_non_atomic_field'
" Auto-fix on save let g:ale_fixers = { \ 'rust': ['rustfmt'], \} let g:ale_fix_on_save = 1
" Show errors in sign column let g:ale_sign_error = '✗' let g:ale_sign_warning = '⚠'
" Jump between errors nmap <silent> [e <Plug>(ale_previous_wrap) nmap <silent> ]e <Plug>(ale_next_wrap)
" Show full error message nmap <silent> <leader>d <Plug>(ale_detail)
" Quick clippy check (Leader + c) nnoremap <leader>c :!cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation<CR>

usage.step: Open Rust file → ALE runs clippy automatically on save
Use [e and ]e to jump between errors
Use \c to run manual clippy check

performance-tuning.description: Optimize clippy check times (cargo check vs clippy, caching strategies)

strategy.name: Incremental Compilation
strategy.enable:
# Enable incremental compilation (speeds up repeated checks) [profile.dev] incremental = true
# Faster linking (LLD linker) [profile.dev] linker = "lld"

strategy.name: Sparse Protocol
strategy.enable: # Use sparse registry protocol (faster dependency fetching) [registries.crates-io] protocol = "sparse"

strategy.name: Parallel Jobs
strategy.enable: # Increase parallel compilation jobs (default: CPU cores) [build] jobs = 8 # Adjust based on CPU cores

strategy.name: Cargo Check First
strategy.workflow:
# Step 1: Fast type check (no lints, no codegen) cargo check --all-targets
# Step 2: Clippy (reuses cargo check cache) cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation
# Total time: 5s (check) + 2s (clippy) = 7s # vs. clippy alone: 15s

strategy.name: Targeted Checks
strategy.workflow:
# Check only modified files (fast iteration) # Use cargo-watch for automatic re-checking on file changes cargo install cargo-watch
# Watch src/ and re-run clippy on changes cargo watch -x 'clippy --all-targets -- -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation'
strategy.speedup: Near-instant feedback (<1s for single file changes)

strategy.name: Clippy Cache
strategy.enable:
# Set clippy cache directory (reuse across projects) export CLIPPY_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/clippy"
# Clear cache if stale (every 30 days) find "$CLIPPY_CACHE_DIR" -type f -mtime +30 -delete

troubleshooting.description: Common issues and solutions when using clippy-capsule-verify

issue.name: rustc_private errors
issue.symptom: error[E0463]: can't find crate for `rustc_hir` --> src/lib.rs:47:1 | 47 | extern crate rustc_hir; | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ can't find crate
issue.cause: clippy-capsule-verify requires nightly Rust (rustc_private crates only available on nightly)
issue.solution:
# Install nightly toolchain rustup install nightly
# Set nightly as default (project-level) rustup override set nightly
# Or use rust-toolchain.toml cat > rust-toolchain.toml << 'EOF' [toolchain] channel = "nightly-2024-01-01" components = ["rustc-dev", "llvm-tools"] EOF
# Verify nightly is active rustc --version # Output: rustc 1.XX.0-nightly (...)

issue.name: Lint not detected
issue.symptom: warning: unknown lint: `clippy::capsule_mutex_violation` | = note: `#[warn(unknown_lints)]` on by default
issue.solution:
# Option 1: Set CLIPPY_CONF_DIR export CLIPPY_CONF_DIR=/path/to/clippy-capsule-verify cargo clippy
# Option 2: Load via rustflags export RUSTFLAGS="--extern clippy_capsule_verify=/path/to/target/release/libclipper_capsule_verify.so" cargo clippy
# Option 3: Add to .cargo/config.toml cat >> .cargo/config.toml << 'EOF' [target.'cfg(all())'] rustflags = [ "--extern", "clippy_capsule_verify=/path/to/clippy-capsule-verify/target/release/libclipper_capsule_verify.so" ] EOF

issue.name: False positives (verification not detected)
issue.symptom: warning: capsule struct `MyVerifiedCapsule` is missing compile-time verification --> src/my_module.rs:10:1 | 10 | #[repr(C, align(64))] | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
issue.cause: Verification macro in different module or misspelled

issue.name: Performance degradation
issue.symptom: Clippy checks taking 60+ seconds (much slower than expected)
issue.cause: Missing incremental compilation, no LLD linker, clean builds
issue.solution:
# Enable incremental compilation cat >> Cargo.toml << 'EOF' [profile.dev] incremental = true EOF
# Use LLD linker (30% faster) cat >> .cargo/config.toml << 'EOF' [build] rustflags = ["-C", "link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld"] EOF
# Install LLD # Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install lld # macOS: brew install llvm
# Clear stale cache (if very slow) cargo clean cargo clippy # Will be slow first time, then fast

issue.name: Hook errors
issue.cause: Git hooks don't inherit shell environment (no cargo in PATH)
issue.solution:
# Add cargo to PATH in git hook cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Add cargo to PATH export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Now cargo is available cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# Verify cargo is found .git/hooks/pre-commit

issue.name: Suppression not working

migration-workflow.description: Step-by-step guide for adding clippy-capsule-verify to existing projects

phase.name: Audit
phase.step: Install clippy-capsule-verify (build from source or use binary)
Run initial audit: cargo clippy 2>&1 | tee audit.txt
Count violations by type: grep -E "capsule_|missing_capsule" audit.txt | sort | uniq -c
Categorize by priority: P0 (must fix), P1 (should fix), P2 (nice to have)
Create tracking document: violations.md with per-file breakdown

phase.name: Fix P0 Critical
phase.step: Fix CAPSULE_MUTEX_VIOLATION: Replace Mutex with AtomicU64
Fix CAPSULE_UNALIGNED_VIOLATION: Add padding fields to align size
Fix CAPSULE_MISSING_GENERATION: Add generation counters to T1 capsules
Fix CAPSULE_NON_ATOMIC_FIELD: Replace non-atomic fields with atomics
Validate: cargo clippy -- -D clippy::capsule_mutex_violation (must pass)

phase.name: Fix P1 High
phase.step: Add verification macros to unverified capsules
Use #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] for simple capsules
Manual verification for complex patterns (DualAtomicU64, SIMD, etc)
Validate: cargo clippy -- -W clippy::missing_capsule_verification (zero warnings)

phase.name: Enable Local Enforcement
phase.step: Create .clippy.toml with P0 lints set to "deny"
Install git hooks (pre-commit, pre-push)
Configure editor integration (VSCode/Neovim)
Test hooks: .git/hooks/pre-commit (must pass)

phase.name: Documentation
phase.step: Document suppression guidelines (when acceptable, when not)
Add examples to README (before/after fixes)
Create onboarding guide for new developers
Add clippy-capsule-verify to CONTRIBUTING.md
